summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8, buck): evaluated 14 same-category OPNs, surfacing 0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 8 Level 3 Layout Change options. Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck, external Schottky diode), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOIC-8.
Re-verify switching frequency (570 kHz), inductor value (6.8 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (0.8 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
